summary: Rafael Holdings furnished an 8-K under Items 7.01/8.01/9.01 disclosing topline results from its Cyclo Therapeutics subsidiary's pivotal Phase 3 TransportNPC trial (CTD-TCNPC-301) of Trappsol Cyclo in 94 Niemann-Pick Disease Type C patients. The primary endpoint, change in the 4-domain NPC Clinical Severity Scale at Week 96, missed statistical significance though showing a directionally favorable effect; a prespecified subgroup on background miglustat and/or leucine, about 83% of patients, reached significance. Safety was well tolerated with no new signals. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were stated, so the filing is not a special situation.
